invariants.rule: Exactly one public policy state bit is set at the Stage 2G policy boundary.
POST_CLEAR_RECOVERY_PENDING implies RESET_WAIT_STATE and excludes CLEAR_PENDING.
All bitmaps are zero outside FAULT_LATCHED_STATE.
Capture the complete first clean cause set once per active episode.
OR each clean eligible cause set during the active episode.

current_monitor_pair.description: I_CH1 and I_CH2 are updated together from one destination-FIFO delivery, but separate software reads can straddle two deliveries.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_MISMATCH_OR_DIFFERENTIAL
fault_causes.description: The channel differential exceeded the sensor mismatch threshold.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_OPEN
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-open detector asserted.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_SATURATION
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-saturation detector asserted.

fault_causes.name: SENSOR_STUCK
fault_causes.description: At least one sensor-stuck detector asserted.

fields.name: pwm_enable
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: clear_fault_pulse
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write of WDATA[1]=1 emits one ACLK pulse regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: fault_valid
fields.read_behavior: Returns the evaluation result three ACLK edges after the corresponding accepted atomic raw CDC destination delivery; it is not a continuously live classifier signal.

fields.name: fault_latched
fields.read_behavior: Retains its prior value through post-clear RESET_WAIT and clears only on a later clean healthy evaluation entering ARMED.

fields.name: fault_code_latched
fields.read_behavior: Retains the prior first cause with fault_latched through post-clear RESET_WAIT.

fields.name: i_ch1_mon
fields.read_behavior: A single register read is stable; a later I_CH2 read can observe a different delivery.

fields.name: i_ch2_mon
fields.read_behavior: A single register read is stable; an earlier I_CH1 read can have observed a different delivery.

fields.name: threshold_ch1
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: threshold_ch2
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: diff_threshold
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[11:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: pwm_period
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[15:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: pwm_duty
fields.write_behavior: An accepted write stores WDATA[15:0] regardless of which nonzero WSTRB accepted the transaction.

fields.name: atomic_multi_register_snapshot
fields.read_behavior: Returns zero because no atomic multi-register snapshot is provided.

fields.name: BACKPRESSURE_SEEN

fields.name: sequence

fields.name: sequence
fields.read_behavior: Returns the ACLK-domain destination value and is not part of an atomic multi-register snapshot.
